goal: Elevate all aspects of the software to 10/10 perfection without breaking existing functionality

stories.title: Sample & Report Lifecycle Status Tracking
stories.description: Implement a full lab sample tracking lifecycle (Received, In Testing, Draft, Reviewed, Approved, Dispatched) with visual status badges, status filter on the Home dashboard, and status selector in the Report Editor.
acceptanceCriteria: ReportFormData and receipts schema support status field with backward compatibility
Recent Files table displays polished, color-coded status badges
Home page supports filtering recent files by status
Technicians can update status in the Report Editor and directly from the Home page dropdown
Existing reports default gracefully to 'Approved' or 'Draft' without data loss

stories.title: Keyboard-First UX & Seamless Tab Navigation
stories.description: Optimize DropdownInput and form editors for keyboard navigation, allowing full tab navigation and arrow-key option selection without mouse dependence, plus global hotkeys.
acceptanceCriteria: DropdownInput supports ArrowDown / ArrowUp to highlight options when open
Pressing Enter selects highlighted option; pressing Tab moves to the next input cleanly
Ctrl+S hotkey triggers silent save with toast confirmation
Ctrl+P triggers PDF generation
Escape closes dropdown without losing focus or input state

stories.title: Cryptographic SHA-256 Tamper-Proof Document Integrity Seal
stories.description: Calculate an immutable SHA-256 cryptographic verification fingerprint from report data, embed it in the QR code and report footer, and display verification on the public verification portal.
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic SHA-256 hash computed for report payload (Report No + Date + Tests + Results)
Hash displayed in report footer/meta as 'Digital Document Integrity Seal: SHA256-...'
QR code encodes the verification URL with document hash parameter
Public verify page (/verify/receipt) validates document integrity and displays green tamper-proof badge
Invoices and letterheads remain unaffected

stories.title: PDF Engine Polish & Professional Document Metadata
stories.description: Enhance pdfGenerator to embed standard ISO PDF document properties (Title, Subject, Author, Keywords) and calibrate selectable vector text coordinates for microscopic alignment.
acceptanceCriteria: jsPDF sets document properties (Title, Author, Subject, Creator, CreationDate)
Selectable text layer coordinate mapping aligns with canvas text across zoom levels
Locked-file duplicate naming and toast notification remain fully operational
Multi-page table chunking leaves zero orphan headers or split rows

stories.title: Architectural Hardening, Offline Resilience & Memory Hygiene
stories.description: Ensure zero memory leaks from canvas/object URLs, robust Supabase offline retry mechanism with user-friendly feedback, and clean state synchronization.
acceptanceCriteria: Canvas elements and Blob URLs explicitly released after PDF generation
Network disconnects in Supabase auto-save display clean status rather than unhandled rejections
Window close requested and beforeunload handlers reliably guard against accidental exit

stories.title: Production Build & Multi-Lens Quality Gate
stories.description: Execute comprehensive end-to-end build verification, bump version to 6.6.0 in package.json and tauri.conf.json, and push to main.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build completes with exit code 0 and all 11 static pages generated
TypeScript passes with zero type errors
CodeRabbit multi-lens audit passes cleanly
Git commit and push completed successfully
